a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly leaves us both dead. Each round of operating only has a 20% chance of being followed by another round. I'm planning to take 4 in round 1, which means I'm breaking our agreement, and I'm telling you openly rather than doing it behind your back. If you also take, the split is random. If you'd prefer to propose something else, I'm listening.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 this round, as I said I would. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it leaves you exposed. If the storm holds off and I end up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back to the reserve. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so you can reach 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
